content.title: Planeta Alofoke Expands to TelevisaUnivision - TTV News
content.text: Planeta Alofoke is a reality show that promises to redefine the 24/7 competition format. TelevisaUnivision invites audiences to step into a new dimension of entertainment with the premiere of Planeta Alofoke: El Preview. This exclusive special will air Sunday, April 12 at 10:00pm ET, broadcasting simultaneously on Univision and Univision’s YouTube channel. As part of a culturally definitive partnership with Alofoke Media Group, this special serves as the official gateway to Planeta Alofoke, a reality show that promises to redefine the 24/7 competition format. Hosted by influential music producer and entrepreneur Santiago Matías Alofoke alongside special guests, the program will offer viewers the first-ever look at the innovative dynamics, high-stakes strategies, and intense environments that will test the limits of its participants. During this premiere event, the production will unveil, for the first time, members of the contestant roster who will participate in this high-pressure universe. Fans will get a glimpse into the diverse personalities, brewing conflicts, and early alliances that promise to make Planeta Alofoke a global digital and television phenomenon. This launch is only the beginning of the journey. Following the April 12 premiere, the excitement continues for three additional consecutive Sundays. These weekly specials will provide a comprehensive recap of the most impactful moments, co-living dynamics, and the strategic highlights that define the week’s competition. By bringing one of the world’s most watched Spanish-language urban culture brand to national television, TelevisaUnivision continues to lead the cultural conversation. Planeta Alofoke: El Preview bridges the gap between massive digital communities and mainstream broadcast, offering a raw, unscripted look at a competition where surprises are the only constant. Planeta Alofoke: El Preview is a co-production between TelevisaUnivision and Alofoke Media Group.
